requirements.text: Respond electronically through OpenGov; no email response.
Register with OpenGov to participate in active County solicitations.
Acknowledge any issued addenda in OpenGov.
RFI is information gathering only; County may use responses for future procurement planning.
Identify limitations, assumptions, and dependencies.
Secure internal access and modern identity integration.
MFA for external users where appropriate; provisioning/deprovisioning/admin controls.
Intuitive external submission for attorneys, self-represented litigants and other authorized users.
Desktop/mobile uploads and email/text action notifications.
Internal review, statuses/classifications, confidentiality/restriction, evidence/exhibit workflows and multiple case/hearing types.
Track physical evidence/exhibits and support juror review during deliberations.
Maintain auditable chain of custody for all evidence and exhibits.
Record activity for all file actions, including viewing.
Lock accepted evidence where required and prevent unauthorized modification after acceptance/finalization.
Search/retrieve by case criteria and metadata; inventory/reporting including retention/closure/destruction review.
Retention by applicable legal periods; identify closure/destruction candidates.
Approval-based destruction, advance notice/copy opportunity where permitted, appeal/records retrieval and explicit permanent-deletion behavior.
Case/hearing lookup through case-management integration; APIs/interoperability with court systems and workflow variations including remote participation.
Secure isolated test/training environment that mirrors production, plus admin/internal/external training and ongoing support/user guides.
Administrative roles/tools and evidence/exhibit management throughout retention period.
Encrypt data in transit and at rest; store court records in the United States.
Meet applicable criminal-justice/judicial cloud security requirements and protect confidentiality; prohibit unauthorized use/mining/access.
Third-party/law-enforcement access only through authorized records-custodian processes where required.
Virus scanning/protective controls, backup/recovery, disaster recovery and business continuity.
Large-file support; major video/audio/image/document formats; authorized copy formats; physical evidence placeholders/tags; sort/filter; pre-submission editing tools.
Responder bears all response costs.
All inquiries must go through OpenGov Q&A.
Confirm RFI is not a proposal solicitation and response will not be treated as a proposal.
Upload complete response; email responses are not accepted.
